title: MusicDrop v1.4.3 Available
changelog:
• Default Fill (Crop) Video Mode: Video now defaults to full bleed Fill (Crop) scaling on launch, eliminating letterbox gaps and filling the top screen completely
• Seamless Full-Bleed Top Screen: Softened top status bar scrim to let the vibrant video stream show edge-to-edge all the way to the top bezel
• Up Next Bottom Half-Screen: Replaced bottom card Save button with 'Up Next' button, opening a half-screen interactive sheet with current track and upcoming queue tracks
• Frosted Glass Transparent Skin: New audio player skin matching YouTube Music style with dynamic blurred album art backdrop, centered rounded artwork, Song | Lyrics toggle, and transparent frosted glass floating music controls
